offence_note: Fraud on band council of about $140,000 as social assistance administrator
sentence_quote: I sentence the accused to 20 months to be served on a conditional basis on the mandatory statutory terms set out in s. 742.3(1) of the Criminal Code
note: Band favouring alternatives to jail accepted as mitigating; Gladue considered but weight not explicit.

offence_note: Extortion and threatening committed while in custody
sentence_quote: the sentence actually imposed (3 years) reflects recognition of the totality principle
note: Sentence consecutive to existing sentence being served.

offence_note: Producing marihuana and possession for trafficking, grow operation
sentence_quote: I sentence the accused in the case at bar to two years less one day on each count, concurrent.
note: Conditional sentence refused; deterrence of grow operations emphasised.

offence_note: Sexual assault, sexual interference, invitation to sexual touching of child
sentence_quote: I would substitute a sentence of four years' imprisonment concurrent on all counts for the three-year sentence imposed by the trial judge
note: Ancillary orders unchanged but not listed in text shown.

offence_note: Large fraud and uttering forged documents, limited partnership scheme
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal sentence but dismiss the sentence appeals.

offence_note: Offence not stated; young offender convicted
sentence_quote: We are not persuaded that the sentence of four months open custody and community service is demonstrably unfit.
note: Offence unknown; community service hours not stated; open custody.

offence_note: Second degree murder by stabbing, youth sentenced as adult
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed the mandatory adult sentence of life imprisonment without eligibility for parole for seven years.
note: FASD fresh evidence gave no reason to vary sentence; federal penitentiary placement.

offence_note: Concealed weapon and weapon for dangerous purpose in detention centre
sentence_quote: In our view, the 18 month sentence was fit, particularly in view the appellant’s record, even when the totality principle is taken into account.
note: 18 months concurrent on each count, consecutive to sentence being served.

offence_note: Robbery; sentence appeal for enhanced pre-sentence custody credit
sentence_quote: the sentence on the robbery charge is varied to 15 months' imprisonment
note: Reduced from 16 months for 1.5:1 credit on two months custody; 30 days concurrent theft not under review.

offence_note: Possession of stolen mail and identity theft
sentence_quote: the appeal is allowed only to the extent that the appellant's sentence for Count 4 of a further one year and 340 days' imprisonment is reduced to a further one year and 271 days' imprisonment.
note: Global 4 years; credit raised to 459 days; Count 4 remaining term 1 year 271 days.

offence_note: Criminal harassment; other convictions set aside for new trial
sentence_quote: I would reduce the sentence of imprisonment imposed by the trial judge from 18 months to 6 months.
note: Section 109 weapons prohibition set aside; other ancillary orders and probation kept.

offence_note: Sexual interference with 14-year-old boy in care by support worker
sentence_quote: You will serve a term of imprisonment of 729 days less time served. Time served prior to sentencing is set at 106 days.
note: Complainant Indigenous, not offender; victim surcharge waived; SOIRA 20 years.
